items: USPS to detail service cuts in Q1 2027. Postmaster General David Steiner told the Board of Governors on Nov. 10 that USPS will have fully developed plans in the first quarter of 2027 to rationalize its retail footprint and non-First-Class Mail service standards. No rate or service change takes effect now.

FedEx adds weekly 777F flights from China. FedEx said four of five new weekly Boeing 777F flights link Shanghai and Guangzhou to the U.S., and it added a five-times-weekly China connection to Dallas–Fort Worth via Anchorage. FedEx announced no rate or fee changes.

FedEx Import Tool adds online duty payment. FedEx added integrated duty and tax payment to its FedEx Import Tool, available in the Philippines and several other Asia-Pacific markets. Philippine importers can pay by card, e-wallet or bank transfer, and FedEx said the tool is free for account holders and customers without accounts.
